    <div><h2><a href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eswa.2026.133261">DRIFT in Expert Systems with Applications</a></h2><p>Good to see this one out! In DRIFT, we use both the target and local LiDAR geometry to guide a recurrent diffusion model as it generates trajectories.</p></div>

  <article class="news-item">
